code:
1024 shots, 540 counts of "0"

phat = 540/1024    = 0.52734
SE   = 0.015625  (same n, same p0)
z    = (phat-.5)/SE  = 1.75

At 95% (|z|<1.96): PASSES
well within normal sampling variance
caption: A comfortably passing z-score for a fair coin at this shot count.
